Extensions can be moved using `--extensions-dir "$XDG_DATA_HOME/cursor/extensions"` in a wrapper script and updating your `.desktop` file.

However, `argv.json`, agent memory, and global rules (`rules/`) are still hardcoded here.

_Relevant issues:_ https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/162712 , https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/3884

Created on remote hosts. Relocatable via the client's `settings.json`:

```json
"cursor.serverInstallFolderPath": {
  "my-host": "$HOME/.local/share/cursor-server"
}
```

Global SSH defaults are unsupported.

_Relevant issue:_ https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/3884
